outcome: Trends in bariatric surgery before pregnancy
cohort: 14,648,135 patients who had vaginal or cesarean delivery
finding: There is a gradual increase of pregnancy after bariatric surgery in recent years in the United States, and while these patients are more likely to require blood transfusion, severe maternal morbidity is similar to those without prior bariatric surgery.
mod_finding: Patients with prior bariatric surgery were more likely to have a cesarean delivery.
